name: External Post Trade Bond 1 Code
definition: Information related to the post trade of bonds.

FULG.name: Full Details With Previously Aggregated
FULG.definition: Full details flag G for Individual transactions in sovereign bonds which have previously benefited from aggregated publication.

FULO.name: Full Details With Previously Omitted
FULO.definition: Full details flag O for transactions in a sovereign bond which has previously benefitted from the omission of the publication of the volume.

LIF4.name: Large Illiquid
LIF4.definition: Flag for transactions in bonds benefiting from a deferral applicable to transactions of a large size in a financial instrument for which there is not a liquid market.

LLF3.name: Large Liquid
LLF3.definition: Flag for transactions in bonds benefiting from a deferral applicable to transactions of a large size in a financial instrument for which there is a liquid market.

MIF2.name: Medium Illiquid
MIF2.definition: Flag for transactions in bonds benefiting from a deferral applicable to transactions of a medium size in a financial instrument for which there is not a liquid market.

NEGO.name: Negotiated Transaction
NEGO.definition: Flag for transactions which are negotiated privately but reported under the rules of a trading venue.

MLF1.name: Medium Liquid
MLF1.definition: Flag for transactions in bonds benefiting from a deferral applicable to transactions of a medium size in a financial instrument for which there is a liquid market.

TPAC.name: Package Transaction
TPAC.definition: Flag for package transactions, which are not exchange for physicals.

PORT.name: Portfolio Transaction
PORT.definition: Flag for transactions in five or more different financial instruments where those transactions are traded at the same time by the same client.||It is used against a single lot price and that is not a ‘package transaction'.

VIF5.name: Very Large Illiquid
VIF5.definition: Flag for transactions in bonds benefiting from a deferral applicable to transactions of a very large size in a financial instrument for which there is not a liquid market.

VLF5.name: Very Large Liquid
VLF5.definition: Flag for transactions in bonds benefiting from a deferral applicable to transactions of a very large size in a financial instrument for which there is a liquid market

OMIS.name: Volume Omission
OMIS.definition: Flag for transactions in a sovereign bond which benefits from the omission of the publication of the volume.
